id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_030.pack|cs_: "I can't see the writing from here! We have to get closer!
"Entering the Celestial Sands is dangerous. Even for a Prince, I can't obey that order.
"Then can you decipher the writing from here!?
"W-Well... that is...
"Hee hee, Princey, long time no see!
"Oh! {var:1}! Sylvando! It's been a while! You're safe!
"The Sultan told me everything. You came to investigate that star, didn't you? You've grown up a lot!
"Heh, not really... I'm just doing my duty as Prince. But why are you all here?
"We came for the same reason as you: to investigate Erdwin's Lantern.
"Y-You're Hendrik, Heliodor's Hero! To meet you here!
"You know my name?
"Of course! You're every knight's dream! I've worked hard aiming to join your unit!
"I'm glad to hear it, but even without joining my unit, your courage to protect the people makes you a fine knight.
"Ah! Praise from Hendrik himself! I'm moved!
"But, Prince, from the look of it, your investigation is struggling.
"You're right, old man. The scholar got cold feet.
"Even I can't decipher the writing, and I wonder what to do...
"Then I'll decipher the ancient writing you found.
"What, old man! You can read ancient writing!? Thank you, that helps!
"The writing should be easiest to see near the ruins at the center of the Celestial Sands. I'll go there ahead!"
